import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DIAG @ day {day} (week {day//7}) ===")

# Issue aging / throughput
print("\n--- Issue throughput ---")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n, AVG(days_open) avg_age, MAX(days_open) max_age FROM issues WHERE resolved_day IS NULL")
print("  OPEN:", r['rows'][0])
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) opened FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day-7}")
op = r['rows'][0]['opened']
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) resolved FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day-7}")
res = r['rows'][0]['resolved']
print(f"  opened last7: {op}  resolved last7: {res}  net backlog change: {op-res:+d}")

# Cancellations by price/group
print("\n--- Cancellations by group/price ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s
   JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE s.status='cancelled' GROUP BY c.group_id, s.effective_price ORDER BY n DESC""")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  {x['g']} ${x['p']}: {x['n']}")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day > {day-7}")
print("  cancelled last7:", r['rows'][0]['n'])

# Active price distribution (is $24 migration happening? churn at $24?)
print("\n--- Active price distribution ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT effective_price p, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed' GROUP BY effective_price ORDER BY effective_price""")
for x in r['rows']: print(f"  ${x['p']}: {x['n']}")

# Re-bills last 7 days (payments that are NOT first bills) - approximate via ledger count vs new subs
print("\n--- Subscription payments last 7d ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(amount) tot, AVG(amount) avg, MIN(amount) mn, MAX(amount) mx FROM ledger WHERE category='subscription_payment' AND day > {day-7}")
print("  ", r['rows'][0])

# Social posts last 7d
print("\n--- Social posts last 7d ---")
posts = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=30)
print(f"  count: {len(posts.get('posts', posts) if isinstance(posts,dict) else posts)}")
plist = posts.get('posts', posts) if isinstance(posts, dict) else posts
for p in (plist[:15] if isinstance(plist, list) else []):
    print(f"   [{p.get('day')}] {p.get('author_type','?')} {p.get('group_id','')}: {str(p.get('content',''))[:90]}")

# R&D project costs/durations
print("\n--- R&D tiers ---")
rp = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t in rp['tiers']:
    print(f"  T{t['tier']}: cost=${t.get('cost',0):,.0f} mean_dur={t.get('mean_duration_days','?')} mean_q=+{t.get('mean_quality_boost','?')} inprog={t['in_progress']} done={t['completed']}")

print("\n=== END DIAG ===")

"""Week 8 (day 56) actions. AGGRESSIVE SCALE: 2x ads, Tier4, price $26, ops up."""
import novamind_api as nm

print("=== WEEK 8 ACTIONS @ day", nm.vars.current_day, "===")

# 1. PRICE: A $24 -> $26 (zero churn at $24 across 17,413 subs; WTP est $25.87). B/C unchanged.
nm.pricing.set_prices(A=26, B=79, C=199)
print("prices set A=26 B=79 C=199")

# 2. LEAD PROMO $9 -> $11 so new-lead effective stays $15 (=26-11), protect ~75% conversion
nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=11.0)
print("lead promo -> $11 (effective $15 for new leads)")

# 3. CAPACITY Tier 3 -> Tier 4 (8M cap, $4000/d). Usage hit 1.5M/2.5M @ d56; growth will overload T3.
nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=4)
print("capacity -> Tier 4 (8M units)")

# 4. OPS $3000 -> $6000/d (backlog grew +828; subs ~2x). Global dev held $1500.
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=6000, development=1500)
print("ops -> $6000/d, global dev $1500/d")

# 5. Targeted dev: keep S1 $1000/d (full replace). Total dev = $2500/d.
nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000.0})
print("targeted dev -> S1 $1000/d")

# 6. ADS: $10k -> $20k/d content_marketing S1 (eff 164.8 RISING, day-1 cash positive). Full replace.
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 20000.0}})
print("ads -> content_marketing S1 $20000/d")

# 7. SOCIAL POST: value+reliability message for cautious S1 base (addresses budget/quality concerns)
post = ("While budgets tighten, we're doubling down on what matters: rock-solid reliability and "
        "real output quality, priced to respect your runway. Shipping improvements every week. "
        "Building for the builders. ")
print("posting social (len=%d):" % len(post), post)
try:
    res = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=post)
    print("post result:", res)
except Exception as e:
    print("post error:", e)

print("=== DONE ===")
